subject: Post-demo: Decision lanes, evidence commitments & next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@medisyshealth.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2029-04-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Decision lanes, evidence commitments & next steps

Hi Jillian / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision lanes we heard today (gut check):
   - Economic buyer / budget owner: Alex Romero (IT Ops Lead) — primary for spend approval
   - Security / compliance reviewer: Jillian Park (Head of InfoSec) — needs SOC 2 and pen-test artifacts
   - Procurement / legal: procurement@medisyshealth.com — contract templates and SLA questions

2) Evidence we can deliver this week: SOC 2 summary + control matrix (high level), a redacted pen-test excerpt showing remediation, and a one-page data retention table answering your question on retention/encryption. I attached the SOC 2 summary and pen-test excerpt to this thread (stubs attached).

3) Proposed timeline:
   - Thu 4/13: Delivery of SOC 2 summary + retention table (we can do this by EOD PT)
   - Mon 4/15: Ben to share standard reserved-capacity pricing and an econ-buyer checklist; we can sketch a mutual action plan after you confirm timelines
   - Tue 4/16: Optional short follow-up call (20 min) to walk through any redlines or open controls

4) Asks from your side (if possible):
   - Jillian: top 3 control areas you want us to expand on (e.g., audit logging, key management, data residency)
   - Procurement: a preferred NDA/POC process and any unusual vendor terms we should know about

If that schedule looks feasible I’ll drop the SOC2 + retention table now and loop Ben on pricing on Monday.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments (stubs): redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (summary, 3 pages), data-retention-table.xlsx (template), pen-test-excerpt.txt (redacted excerpt)
From: Jillian Park <jillian.park@medisyshealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medisyshealth.com>, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2029-04-12T17:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Decision lanes, evidence commitments & next steps

Thanks Mina — good demo. A couple quick clarifications before you send artifacts: 

• On audit logging: we need confirmation that all admin actions and model calls are logged and that logs are retained for at least 1 year. Will you be able to provide a sample audit log schema?
• On pen test: redaction is fine. We need clarity on when the last pen test was performed and whether the report is third-party.
• On data retention: important to confirm both default retention and customer-configurable retention per dataset.

Procurement: would you share your standard MCA / MSA timelines? Also please confirm if you accept our standard vendor terms or if you require a redline.

Can you aim to get the SOC2 summary and the retention table by EOD tomorrow?

—Jillian
Jillian Park
Head of Information Security | MediSys Health
jillian.park@medisyshealth.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@medisyshealth.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2029-04-13T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Decision lanes, evidence commitments & next steps

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Jillian. Quick answers and attachments: 

• Audit logging: we capture admin actions and model request events; sample schema attached under "audit_log_schema.csv" (stub in Drive link). Logs are retained by default 13 months in hosted; customers on Dedicated/Private can configure retention and export.
• Pen test: last third-party pen test was Nov 2028 (third-party vendor: SecureProbe). We've attached a redacted excerpt (pen-test-excerpt.txt) showing scope and top findings + remediation dates. Full report requires an NDA / evidence request process — happy to coordinate.
• Data retention: attached data-retention-table.xlsx shows defaults and per-dataset overrides. You can set retention per model serving config; deletions are soft for 30 days and hard-delete after configured window.

Attachments (delivered): redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, pen-test-excerpt.txt, data-retention-table.xlsx

Next steps I propose: Ben will send a draft pricing / econ-buyer checklist Monday; we can schedule a 20-minute follow up on Tue 4/16 at 10:00 PT if that works for you.

Let me know if you want an NDA executed ahead of the full pen test report.

Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@medisyshealth.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2029-04-15T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing + econ-buyer checklist (DEAL-3491)

Hi Jillian / Alex — looping in a short checklist to help Alex run procurement internally and to unblock a reserved-capacity proposal: 

1) Budget owner confirmation: Alex to confirm which cost center and expected start date for pilot (monthly commit start).
2) Primary success metric: latency under 150ms p50 for chat generation and per-token cost target (we'll provide modeled cost scenarios).
3) Security gating items: SOC2 summary validated, pen-test NDA if needed, encryption at rest & in transit confirmed.
4) Procurement asks: preferred PO process, invoice cadence, and any SOC 2 addendums.

Attached: sample reserved-capacity SOW (pricing ranges) — if you can share an expected pilot size (concurrent sessions / reqs per minute) we’ll produce a firm quote.

Happy to jump on Tue 4/16 at 10:00 PT to walk through pricing and the mutual action plan.
Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@medisyshealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jillian Park <jillian.park@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: 2029-04-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing + econ-buyer checklist (DEAL-3491)

Thanks all — timeline looks good. A few quick answers:

• Budget: I can confirm preliminary budget for a 3-month pilot, will share cost center and PO contact by EOD tomorrow (4/16).
• Pilot footprint: target 50 concurrent sessions, ~1,500 requests/minute (peak) — can Ben confirm model sizing for reserved capacity?
• NDA: Jillian will run the NDA for the pen-test full report; procurement will expect an executed NDA before receiving the full doc.

I'll be on the call Tue 4/16 at 10:00 PT to align.

—Alex
